title: fix(cloud-connection): name the cloud-binding service in its contract, and read an empty controlPlaneUrl one way
body:
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DD5m3UuAxayNiHrDSFDaU94)_ Fixes #30762 Clause-②: yes (widening) Metadata-protocol: none domain:server#5 card thread · session `session_016WV4cwsvPqjJfJthsRiYpt` · branch `claude/project-thread-ms359b` (named in the seat's re-posted claim on the card, with the widened file surface). Branched from `main` at 33043bd8; `origin/main` merged at d1e31826. The two should-fixes of the contract review on PR #30749 (record 6673473934, ④ items 1 and 2). Item 2 takes the card's first route (A): the routes read the binding. ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么:① `cloud-binding` 这个服务名现在只在 spec 契约里写一次(`CLOUD_BINDING_SERVICE`,和另外六个契约的做法一样),cloud-connection 注册、service-push 推送中继读取都用它;② cloud-connection 插件的路由不再自己读 `controlPlaneUrl`,改读它自己注册的 `cloud-binding` 服务,所以「显式传空字符串」对路由和推送中继都是「没配云端」。 - 为什么改:PR #30749 的契约复核留下两条 should-fix:服务名两处各写一份、互不约束;同一个空选项,路由当「未配置」,绑定服务却当「用默认云地址」,同一插件里两种读法。 - 风险与回滚:`objectstack serve` 和 showcase 行为不变(它们只用 `resolveCloudUrl()` 的非空结果组装插件,两种读法对它返回同一值);只有手工组装内核时才有差别,见下方 Acceptance notes 三条。spec 只多一个导出;service-push 原有的 `CLOUD_BINDING_SERVICE` 导出保留(改为转导出,值不变)。回滚即 revert,无迁移。 - 先看:`packages/cloud-connection/src/cloud-binding.ts` 的 `resolveBindingUrl`;`packages/cloud-connection/src/cloud-connection-plugin.ts` 里 `const cloudUrl = this.binding.controlPlaneUrl();` 那一行;`packages/spec/src/contracts/cloud-binding-service.ts` 末尾的新导出。 - 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection exec vitest run src/cloud-connection-plugin.test.ts src/cloud-binding.test.ts`,预期全绿,其中「the routes and the binding read the control-plane URL once」一组 6 条覆盖空值、空白、`OS_CLOUD_URL=off`、显式 URL、仅环境变量五种情况。 - 需要你做的:无,席位落地(本 PR 触 `packages/spec/src/**` 且 `Clause-②: yes`,席位 ACCEPT 前需契约复核)。 ## What changes **1. One spelling of the service name.** `packages/spec/src/contracts/cloud-binding-service.ts` exports `CLOUD_BINDING_SERVICE = 'cloud-binding'` beside `ICloudBindingService`, as `EMBEDDER_SERVICE`, `KNOWLEDGE_SERVICE`, `OWNERSHIP_QUEUE_SERVICE`, `RLS_MEMBERSHIP_RESOLVER_SERVICE`, `SEED_SETTLEMENT_SERVICE` and `FILE_ATTACHMENT_SERVICE` do. `api-surface/contracts.json` and `export-origins/contracts.json` regenerated (`gen:api-surface`, `gen:export-origins`): one row each, `CLOUD_BINDING_SERVICE (const)`. - `@objectstack/cloud-connection`: the local constant in `cloud-binding.ts` is gone. It was not a public export of the package (`src/index.ts` never re-exported it), so nothing outside the package loses a name. `CloudConnectionPlugin` imports the contract's constant for `providesServices` and `registerService`. - `@objectstack/service-push`: `transports/relay.ts` imports the contract's constant. `CLOUD_BINDING_SERVICE` **was** a public export of the package (`src/index.ts`), so `relay.ts` keeps it as a re-export (`export { CLOUD_BINDING_SERVICE }`), same name, same value; `index.ts` is untouched. **2. One reading of an empty `controlPlaneUrl` (route A).** At `main`, `createCloudBinding` answered `resolveCloudUrl(option)`, which reads an explicit `''` as unset and falls through to `OS_CLOUD_URL` and the production default, while the plugin's routes read `(option ?? OS_CLOUD_URL ?? '')` and treated `''` as "cloud not configured". - `createCloudBinding`'s `controlPlaneUrl()` is now `resolveCloudUrl`'s answer except that an explicit empty or blank option answers `''`, the reading the routes always gave it. - The routes take `cloudUrl` from `this.binding.controlPlaneUrl()` (still read once at `kernel:ready`, where the env was read before), so the routes and the push relay sender read one answer. - The contract's docblock already says `controlPlaneUrl()` is `''` when the deployment declared no control plane; a host composing the plugin with `controlPlaneUrl: ''` is that declaration, so the contract text is unchanged and the reading is written down on the option (`CloudBindingOptions.controlPlaneUrl`, `CloudConnectionPluginConfig.controlPlaneUrl`). One changeset, `.changeset/30762-cloud-binding-service-name.md`: `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/cloud-connection`, `@objectstack/service-push`, all `patch`. ## Tests - `cloud-connection/src/cloud-connection-plugin.test.ts`, new top-level describe "the routes and the binding read the control-plane URL once": boots the plugin through `init()` and `start()`, drives `GET /installed` (multi-tenant, service key set) and reads the registered binding. An explicit `''` and `' '` with `OS_CLOUD_URL` set: binding `''`, no control-plane call, the disconnected answer. A declined `OS_CLOUD_URL=off` under an absent option: binding `''`, no call. A configured URL and an env-only URL: the route calls exactly `${binding}/api/v1/cloud/environments/env-123/packages`. - `cloud-connection/src/cloud-binding.test.ts`: `controlPlaneUrl()` is `''` for an explicit `''` or `' '`, with and without `OS_CLOUD_URL`; `CLOUD_BINDING_SERVICE` is `'cloud-binding'` (the wire name), and the registration test reads the contract's constant. - `service-push/src/push-plugin.test.ts`: the two tests that place a binding now register it under the contract's `CLOUD_BINDING_SERVICE` instead of the literal, so the registrar's test and the reader's test meet on one constant (the cross-package pin the review asked for).
Ablations (each red, each restored; scripts/ablation-replace.mjs WRAP mode, git diff HEAD empty after each) | # | Mutation | Test run | Red | |:--|:--|:--|:--| | A1 | routes read the option `main`'s way (`option ?? OS_CLOUD_URL ?? ''`) | `cloud-connection-plugin.test.ts` | 1 of 17: the declined `OS_CLOUD_URL` case (`main`'s routes called `off/api/...`) | | A2 | binding answers `resolveCloudUrl(option)` (`main`'s shape) | `cloud-binding.test.ts` + `cloud-connection-plugin.test.ts` | 4 of 26: both empty-option binding pins, both empty-option route pins | | B1 | `relay.ts` declares its own `CLOUD_BINDING_SERVICE = 'cloud_binding'` | `push-plugin.test.ts` | 2 of 19: the bound send and the bind-without-restart case | | B2 | the plugin registers under a local `'cloud_binding'` | `cloud-binding.test.ts` + `cloud-connection-plugin.test.ts` | 6 of 26: the registration test and all five route/binding pins | `cloud-connection` tests import the plugin and the binding from `src/` by relative path, and `service-push` aliases `@objectstack/spec/contracts` to source (below), so no dist rebuild sits between a mutation and its run.
## Acceptance notes - **Route A, and what it moves beyond `''`.** Reading the routes' URL through the binding also aligns two other options, both reachable only on a hand-composed kernel: (a) an absent option with a declined `OS_CLOUD_URL` (`off`, `none`, `local`, `disabled`): the routes used `'off'` as a base URL and called `off/api/v1/...`; they now answer `CLOUD_UNCONFIGURED`, as the binding already did. (b) an absent option with `OS_CLOUD_URL` unset or empty: the routes answered `CLOUD_UNCONFIGURED`; they now use the ObjectStack-operated default, as the binding, `MarketplaceProxyPlugin` and `MarketplaceInstallLocalPlugin` (`resolveCloudUrl(config.controlPlaneUrl)`) already did, and as the config docblock now says. - **`objectstack serve` is unchanged.** `planMarketplaceWiring` composes the plugin only when `resolveCloudUrl()` is non-empty and passes that value (`serve.ts`, `createCloudConnectionPlugin({ singleEnvironment: true, controlPlaneUrl: marketplaceUrl })`); `examples/app-showcase` does the same. That value is already trimmed, slash-stripped and not a decline spelling, so `main`'s route expression and `resolveBindingUrl` both return it byte-for-byte. - **Not changed:** `MarketplaceProxyPlugin` and `MarketplaceInstallLocalPlugin` still read an explicit `''` through `resolveCloudUrl` (as the default). They are outside this card's surface and are never composed with `''` by `serve`; noted, not filed. - **Surface widened (claim re-posted by the seat):** `packages/services/service-push/vitest.config.ts` gains one anchored alias, `/^@objectstack\/spec\/contracts$/` → `../../spec/src/contracts/index.ts`. Gate-forced: `relay.ts` now imports a VALUE from that subpath, and without the alias `check:test-source-alias` exits 1 on service-push ("tests import 1 workspace package(s) that resolve to `dist/` with no source alias"); `KNOWN_UNALIASED_TEST_IMPORTS` is shrink-only. With it the gate exits 0. `push-plugin.test.ts` is the other widened path (above). - `Metadata-protocol: none`, re-derived from the diff: no metadata author writes a key, value or type this changes. `Clause-②: yes (widening)`: one added export on `@objectstack/spec/contracts`. - Serial check before the first push: open PRs touching `packages/cloud-connection/**` or `service-push/**`: only #30935, which edits `cloud-connection-ui.ts` alone. ## Verification At head `d1e31826` (the merge of `origin/main` 3479c33d; the two incoming commits touch none of this diff's packages). Package tests and ablations ran at `9fdd39ad`, the fix commit, which this head carries unchanged.
Builds, typecheck, package tests - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` (lock VERDICT command-exit 0), then `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/cloud-connection^...' --filter '@objectstack/service-push^...' build` (VERDICT command-exit 0). - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection test`: Test Files 72 passed (72), Tests 925 passed (925). `typecheck` exit 0. - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-push test`: Test Files 5 passed (5), Tests 74 passed (74). `typecheck` exit 0. - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` before regeneration named exactly `api-surface/` and `export-origins/` (plus `test-typecheck-debt.json`, whose `tsc` exited without diagnostics against a stale dist; after a rebuild on the final head `check:generated` exits 0 with all 14 artifacts current).
Gates (dispatch-gates derivation, 88 families + 3 named) - `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 88 families at `d1e31826` (11 changed paths vs merge base 3479c33d). All 88 plus `pnpm lint`, `pnpm check:cli-command-ids` and `pnpm check:adr-symbol-anchors`: **91 of 91 exit 0**. - First pass: 84 exit 0; six `packages/spec` dist readers exited 3 or 1 on a dist built before the `origin/main` merge (declaration stamp mismatch: `check:api-surface`, `check:browser-reachable-entries`, `check:dual-source-exports`, `check:entry-nameability`, `check:exported-any` exit 3, `check:generated` exit 1 naming only `api-surface/`), and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (no whole-tree dist). After `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` the six exit 0; after `turbo run build --concurrency=2` (82 of 82 tasks) `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exits 0 (116 require entries across 71 packages load). - `--ran` reconciliation: 88 derived, 88 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN (exit 0). - `pnpm check:test-source-alias` exits 1 without the new service-push alias and 0 with it. - Exit-code file: `gates-ran-d1e31826.txt` (seat project folder).
